Auto-detect the codec by magic bytes and decompress (default bomb-guard cap)

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Detect the codec by magic bytes, then decompress (the inverse of compress without naming the codec). Resolves only magic-bearing codecs: zstd, gzip, zlib, xz, lzma, bzip2, lz4 (frame), snappy (framed). Headerless codecs (brotli, deflate, lz4_block, snappy_raw) carry no signature and return a per-row 'cannot auto-detect codec (no magic bytes)' error — use the explicit decompress form. Same decompression-bomb guard as decompress (optional max_output_bytes; default 256 MiB). NULL input → NULL.
rows.vgi.doc_md: Auto-detect the codec by magic bytes and decompress, e.g. `decompress_auto(value, 67108864)`. Only magic-bearing codecs resolve; headerless ones error. Returns a `BLOB`.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description":"Auto-detect the codec by magic bytes and decompress a blob to text.","sql":"SELECT compress.main.decompress_auto(compress.main.compress('hi'::BLOB, 'gzip'))::VARCHAR AS plaintext"},{"description":"Auto-detect and decompress a gzip blob with a 64 MiB/row output cap.","sql":"SELECT compress.main.decompress_auto(compress.main.compress('hi'::BLOB, 'gzip'), 67108864) AS plaintext"}]

rows: Return the codec name of a BLOB by magic bytes, or 'unknown'

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Return the codec name a `BLOB` is compressed with ('gzip', 'zstd', 'xz', …) by magic-byte match, validated against a trial decode of the leading block to reject weak-magic false positives. Returns 'unknown' when no signature matches — which includes every HEADERLESS codec (brotli, deflate, lz4_block, snappy_raw carry no magic and can never be detected; use the explicit decompress form for those). Cheap: inspects only the first few bytes plus a bounded trial. Never errors. NULL input → NULL.
rows.vgi.doc_md: Return the codec of a `BLOB` by magic bytes, e.g. `detect_codec(b)` → 'gzip', or 'unknown' for headerless/unrecognized input. Never errors.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description":"Identify the codec of a compressed blob from its magic bytes.","sql":"SELECT compress.main.detect_codec(compress.main.compress('hi'::BLOB, 'zstd')) AS codec"},{"description":"Profile a mixed-codec message column: group messages by the codec sniffed from their magic bytes and total stored vs. decompressed bytes per codec (the headerless brotli message is detected as 'unknown' and left out).","sql":"WITH inbox AS (SELECT id, compress.main.compress(repeat(body, 20)::BLOB, codec) AS payload FROM (VALUES (1, 'zstd', 'temp=21.5;'), (2, 'gzip', 'temp=22.0;'), (3, 'zstd', 'temp=20.9;'), (4, 'bzip2', 'temp=23.1;'), (5, 'brotli', 'temp=19.8;')) AS t(id, codec, body)), sniffed AS (SELECT payload, compress.main.detect_codec(payload) AS codec FROM inbox) SELECT codec, count(*) AS messages, sum(octet_length(payload)) AS stored_bytes, sum(compress.main.decompressed_size(payload, codec)) AS raw_bytes FROM sniffed WHERE codec <> 'unknown' GROUP BY codec ORDER BY codec"}]

Decompress a BLOB with the given codec (default bomb-guard output cap)

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Decompress a `BLOB` with the named codec (the inverse of compress). The optional third argument max_output_bytes is the decompression-bomb guard: decoding aborts the row once output would exceed the cap and returns a per-row error, so the worker never OOMs. NULL/omitted uses the worker's configured default cap (the compress_max_output_bytes ATTACH option / env, default 256 MiB); pass a large value to opt out per call. Malformed, truncated, or wrong-codec input returns a clean per-row error, never a panic. NULL input → NULL.
